title: Special Order No. 310, s. 2018
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
" MANILA

SPECIAL ORDER NO. 310

DESIGNATING THE EXECUTIVE SECRETARY AS OFFICER-IN-
CHARGE ON 09-12 APRIL 2018

WHEREAS, the President will be in Boao, China to participate in the Boao
Forum for Asia on 09-10 April 2018, and in Hong Kong for a working visit on 11-12
April 2018; and .

WHEREAS, to ensure continuity of government™service, it is necessary to
designate an Officer-in-Charge (OIC) to take care of the day-to-day. operations in the
Office of the President and oversee the general administration of the Executive
Department.

NOW, THEREFORE, I, RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE, President of the Republic
of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby order:

1. The Executive Secretary shall act as OIC to take care of the day-to-day
operations in the Office of the President and to oversee the general administration of
the Executive Department, and he shall, if necessary, act for and on behalf of the
President, except on matters that the President is required by the Constitution to act’in
person, during the time that the President is outside the Republic of the Philippines
from 09-12 April 2018. :

2. All departments, agencies, and instrumentalities of the Government shall
assist the Executive Secretary in the discharge of his functions as stated herein.

3. All acts of the Executive Secretary for and on behalf of the President
pursuant to this Order shall be deemed acts of the President unless disapproved or
reprobated by the President.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 3rdday of April, in the year of Our Lord, Two

Thousand and Eighteen.

By the President:

Nanay hd
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA

Executive Secretary

  

REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES PRRD 2016 - 005297
